status: Native slice reviewed offline; no physical receiver acceptance
bead_envelope_method: Convex projection of every emitted path per object, expanded by its largest native bead radius and 0.001 mm arc allowance; bounds/insets are conservative

front_mounting_collar_paths.scope: Actual commanded outer circumferential-road projections against the preceding model layer only. Automatic support is audited separately. Bead overlap and continuous rim paths do not establish adhesion, printed strength, support release or dimensional fit.

description.prepared: This filament is too soft and not compatible with the AMS. Printing it is of many requirements, and to get better printing quality, please refer to this wiki: TPU printing guide.

scope: Commanded paths and bead envelopes only; support release, internal strands, dimensions, sealing and lifetime require the physical article.
